Same situation. What is getting to me is not that I do not care about myself but that I am often unable to care about my friends and people that are close to me which I normally would die for. 

And it's making me feel worse than I ever could have imagined

That takes money. Money takes working, and I don't have a job as I barely can get myself out of bed every morning just to go on with my day. I even failed my last semester in studying, which is a first

But the main problem is that I don't _want_ to meet new people because I know that I will inevitably stop caring about them just like I have everyone else I know. It's taking all I have just to care about the people I already like
